add_block.new_heading: What a private chef in JVC includes
new_paragraphs: A private chef in JVC is a full in-villa dining service, not a food drop-off. One personal chef takes the whole evening off your plate: a menu built around your tastes, the shopping and prep, cooking live in your townhouse kitchen, plated service to the table and a kitchen left cleaner than they found it. For larger tables we add service staff so nobody is stuck refilling plates. You provide the space and the hob; the chef brings the plan, the technique and any specialist kit. Because JVC homes have working family kitchens instead of show kitchens, our chefs are used to cooking a polished multi-course menu from a standard townhouse setup — no rental equipment or venue hire required. From the first hello to the last cleared plate, the experience is designed so you sit with your guests, not in the kitchen.

add_block.new_heading: Private chef in JVC for birthdays, parties and family dinners
new_paragraphs: Most JVC bookings are family dinners at home, birthday and kids' catering, and casual garden gatherings — so the service flexes to match. For an intimate personal chef dinner, expect a calm, plated multi-course evening for two to eight. For a birthday or a JVC dinner party, the chef scales portions, adds sharing platters and keeps the pace lively. For a garden BBQ or pool-side afternoon, we run relaxed live grilling and generous spreads. Kids' parties get their own crowd-pleasing menu alongside the grown-up food. JVC event catering and JVC party catering both run on the same vetted-chef backbone, just sized to your headcount and setting. Tell us the occasion and the number of guests and the format follows — quiet date night, noisy family feast or full home celebration.

add_block.new_heading: Villa dining and logistics in JVC
new_paragraphs: Villa dining in JVC takes little effort to run because the neighbourhood is built for it — street-level access, private parking outside most townhouses and gardens that double as a natural setting for a BBQ or drinks. A villa chef in JVC arrives with the plan and any specialist equipment, sets up in your kitchen, and works to an agreed timeline so courses land when you want them. There is no venue to hire and no logistics puzzle: your home is the venue. For garden events we handle outdoor grilling and weather-aware setups; for indoor dinners we work quietly around your living space. The chef confirms parking, kitchen access and timing before the day, so setup on the night is calm. When the meal is done, the team clears, washes up and packs out, leaving you with the evening and none of the mess.

new_paragraphs: How much does a private chef cost in JVC?
Private dining in JVC starts from about AED 700–950 per person, depending on guest count, menu and service level. Larger groups come down per head; send your numbers for an exact quote.
Which parts of JVC do you serve?
All of JVC — Jumeirah Village Circle townhouses, villas across the districts and the surrounding streets — plus nearby Dubai communities. Confirm your exact address when you enquire.
What's included?
A vetted chef, service staff where needed, plating, setup and the cleanup are all handled for you. You get menu design, cooking in your kitchen, table service and a spotless finish.
How do I book?
Share your date, guest count and address; we match a vetted chef and send an itemised proposal, usually within one business day.
Can a JVC villa chef cook in my townhouse kitchen?
Yes — a villa chef in JVC works comfortably in a standard townhouse kitchen. The chef brings the plan and any specialist kit, uses your hob and oven, and leaves the kitchen as they found it.
Do you cater larger JVC parties and events, not just dinners?
Yes — beyond private dining we handle JVC event catering and party catering: birthdays, kids' parties, garden BBQs and dinner parties, from finger food and grazing spreads to full plated menus.
How far ahead should I book a private chef in JVC?
Three to five days is comfortable for a weekend dinner; larger parties and festive dates want one to two weeks' notice. Short-notice requests are still worth sending.
For private chef jvc, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .
